lessons.description: Talk about studying, exams, right and wrong answers
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 对 / 错 / 记住 / 告诉

grammar.title: Result verbs: 记住, 听到, 看见
grammar.note: A second verb after the first shows the result: 记 (note down, memorise) + 住 (firmly) = to have memorised. 记得 = to remember (still know); 忘 / 忘记 = to forget.

grammar.title: 告诉 / 问 + person + thing
grammar.pattern: 请告诉我你的名字。我问老师。
grammar.note: 告诉 (tell) and 问 (ask) take the person straight after the verb: 告诉他, 问老师. No 'to' is needed.

grammar.title: 对 / 错 and 最好
grammar.pattern: 你说的不对。这个字写错了。你最好早睡。
grammar.note: 对 = right, correct; 不对 / 错 = wrong. Verb + 错 = do it wrong: 写错, 说错. 最好 + verb = 'you'd better…'.

sentences.zh: 明天我们考汉语。
sentences.en: We have a Chinese exam tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 这次考试难不难？
sentences.en: Was this exam hard?

sentences.zh: 我认真学习了，考了九十九分。
sentences.en: I studied hard and got 99 points.

sentences.zh: 这个字你记住了吗？
sentences.en: Have you memorised this character?

sentences.zh: 对不起，我忘了你的名字。
sentences.en: Sorry, I've forgotten your name.

sentences.zh: 你知道图书馆在哪儿吗？
sentences.en: Do you know where the library is?

sentences.zh: 老师问我，我回答对了。
sentences.en: The teacher asked me, and I answered correctly.

sentences.zh: 请告诉我，这个字对不对？
sentences.en: Please tell me — is this character right?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 明天考试，你准备好了吗？
dialogue.en: The exam is tomorrow. Are you ready?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 还没有。我很多汉字都记不住。
dialogue.en: Not yet. I can't remember lots of the characters.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我们一起去图书馆读书吧。
dialogue.en: Let's go study at the library together.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 好。你知道图书馆几点关门吗？
dialogue.en: OK. Do you know when the library closes?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 晚上十点。你最好拿上课本。
dialogue.en: Ten p.m. You'd better bring your textbook.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 明白了，谢谢！
dialogue.en: Got it, thanks!

lines.zh: 上个星期我们考汉语，考试很难。
lines.en: Last week we had a Chinese exam. It was hard.

lines.zh: 考试前，我晚上常常在图书馆认真学习。
lines.en: Before it, I often studied hard in the library in the evening.

lines.zh: 考试的字我都会写。
lines.en: I knew how to write all the characters in the exam.

lines.zh: 最后有一个字写错了，别的都对！
lines.en: In the end one character was wrong, and everything else was right!

questions.question: 考试不难。
questions.questionEn: The exam wasn't hard.

questions.question: 他写错了几个字？
questions.questionEn: How many characters did he get wrong?

lines.zh: A：你记得王老师的手机号吗？
lines.en: A: Do you remember Teacher Wang's mobile number?

lines.zh: B：我忘了。你问一下小月吧。
lines.en: B: I've forgotten. Ask Xiaoyue.

lines.zh: A：小月在哪儿？
lines.en: A: Where's Xiaoyue?

lines.zh: B：在教学楼里，在三楼上课。
lines.en: B: In the classroom building, having class on the third floor.

questions.question: B 记得王老师的手机号。
questions.questionEn: B remembers Teacher Wang's number.

questions.question: 小月在几楼？
questions.questionEn: Which floor is Xiaoyue on?

lessons.description: Welcome a guest, introduce people and move in, out and around
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 进来 / 出去 / 回来

grammar.title: Direction: verb + 来 / 去
grammar.pattern: 请进来！· 他出去了。· 我明天回来。
grammar.note: 来 means movement towards the speaker, 去 away from the speaker. 进来 = come in (to where I am), 进去 = go in. The same with 出, 回, 上, 下.

grammar.title: 听 / 听到 / 听见
grammar.pattern: 你听！· 我听见了。· 你听到了吗？
grammar.note: 听 = to listen. 听到 / 听见 = to hear (the sound reaches you). Negative of the result: 没听见 = didn't hear.

grammar.title: 介绍 — introduce
grammar.pattern: 我介绍一下，这是我的同学。
grammar.note: 介绍一下 is the polite way to start an introduction. 给 + person + 介绍 = introduce to someone: 我给你介绍一个朋友.

sentences.zh: 请进！请坐！
sentences.en: Come in! Have a seat!

sentences.zh: 我介绍一下，这是我的朋友王明。
sentences.en: Let me introduce you — this is my friend Wang Ming.

sentences.zh: 他不在，他出去了。
sentences.en: He's not here; he's gone out.

sentences.zh: 你什么时候回来？
sentences.en: When will you be back?

sentences.zh: 我们晚上十点回到家了。
sentences.en: We got home at ten in the evening.

sentences.zh: 请站起来。……好，请坐下。
sentences.en: Please stand up. … OK, please sit down.

sentences.zh: 你说什么？我没听见。
sentences.en: What did you say? I didn't hear.

sentences.zh: 上课的时候别说话。
sentences.en: Don't talk during class.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你好！请进，请进！
dialogue.en: Hello! Come in, come in!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！这是你的新家吗？
dialogue.en: Thanks! Is this your new home?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 是。请坐。我给你介绍一下，这是我妹妹。
dialogue.en: Yes. Have a seat. Let me introduce you — this is my younger sister.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.zh: 你好！我听哥哥说了很多你的事。
dialogue.en: Hi! My brother has told me lots about you.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 你好！认识你很高兴。
dialogue.en: Hi! Nice to meet you.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你们说话，我出去买一点儿水果。
dialogue.en: You two chat — I'll pop out and buy some fruit.

lines.zh: 上个月我来到北京学习汉语。
lines.en: Last month I came to Beijing to study Chinese.

lines.zh: 第一天上课，老师说：“请站起来，介绍一下。”
lines.en: On the first day the teacher said, 'Please stand up and introduce yourself.'

lines.zh: 我站起来说：“我叫大明，我是外国人。”
lines.en: I stood up and said, 'My name is Daming. I'm from abroad.'

lines.zh: 同学们都听见了，他们说：“你好，大明！”
lines.en: My classmates all heard and said, 'Hi, Daming!'

questions.question: 他上个月来到北京。
questions.questionEn: He came to Beijing last month.

questions.question: 老师请他做什么？
questions.questionEn: What did the teacher ask him to do?

lines.zh: A：你好，王明在家吗？
lines.en: A: Hello, is Wang Ming home?

lines.zh: B：他不在，他出去了。
lines.en: B: He's not in; he's gone out.

lines.zh: A：他什么时候回来？
lines.en: A: When will he be back?

lines.zh: B：晚上六点。你六点再打电话吧。
lines.en: B: At six this evening. Call again at six.

questions.question: 王明在家。
questions.questionEn: Wang Ming is at home.

questions.question: 王明几点回来？
questions.questionEn: What time will Wang Ming be back?

lessons.description: Meet up with friends, help each other and give gifts

grammar.title: 跟 + person + verb — with
grammar.pattern: 我跟朋友见面。他跟我一起去。
grammar.note: 跟 introduces the person you do something with. It goes before the verb, often with 一起.

grammar.title: 给 + person + thing / 给 + person + verb
grammar.pattern: 我给你一本书。我给妈妈打电话。
grammar.note: 给 as a verb means 'give'. Before another verb it means 'for / to someone': 给他买东西. 送 = give as a present, or see someone off.

grammar.title: 帮 vs 帮忙
grammar.pattern: 请帮我拿一下。· 你能帮个忙吗？
grammar.note: 帮 takes a person right after it: 帮我. 帮忙 already has its object inside, so you can't say 帮忙我; say 帮我的忙 or just 帮我.

sentences.zh: 我们明天在哪儿见面？
sentences.en: Where shall we meet tomorrow?

sentences.zh: 我在找我的手机，你看见了吗？
sentences.en: I'm looking for my phone. Have you seen it?

sentences.zh: 找到了！在你的书包里。
sentences.en: Found it! It's in your bag.

sentences.zh: 你能帮我一下吗？
sentences.en: Can you help me for a moment?

sentences.zh: 这本书是我送你的。
sentences.en: This book is my present to you.

sentences.zh: 那个女孩儿是谁？— 她是我女朋友。
sentences.en: Who's that girl? — She's my girlfriend.

sentences.zh: 王先生，这是李小姐。
sentences.en: Mr Wang, this is Ms Li.

sentences.zh: 别生气，我跟你开玩笑呢！
sentences.en: Don't be cross, I'm just joking with you!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你在找谁？
dialogue.en: Who are you looking for?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我在找我的朋友小月。你看见她了吗？
dialogue.en: My friend Xiaoyue. Have you seen her?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 看见了，她跟她男朋友在饭店里。
dialogue.en: Yes — she's in the restaurant with her boyfriend.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 真的吗？她有男朋友了？
dialogue.en: Really? She has a boyfriend now?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我跟你开玩笑呢！是她哥哥。
dialogue.en: Haha, I'm kidding! It's her older brother.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 你真好笑！
dialogue.en: You're so funny!

lines.zh: 昨天在路上，我看见一个小男孩儿站在路口。
lines.en: Yesterday I saw a little boy standing at a street corner.

lines.zh: 他说他找不到妈妈了。
lines.en: He said he couldn't find his mom.

lines.zh: 我帮他给妈妈打电话。
lines.en: I helped him call his mom.

lines.zh: 过了一会儿，他妈妈就来了。小朋友笑了。
lines.en: Soon after, his mom found him. The little boy smiled.

questions.question: 小男孩儿找不到爸爸了。
questions.questionEn: The little boy couldn't find his dad.

questions.question: 最后谁找到了小朋友？
questions.questionEn: Who found the little boy in the end?

lines.zh: A：小月，这本书送你。
lines.en: A: Xiaoyue, this book is for you.

lines.zh: B：给我的？谢谢！
lines.en: B: For me? Thank you!

lines.zh: A：不客气。是别人送我的，我有两本。
lines.en: A: You're welcome. Someone gave it to me — I have two copies.

lines.zh: B：你真好！
lines.en: B: You're so kind!

questions.question: 这本书 A 有两本。
questions.questionEn: A has two copies of this book.

questions.question: A 送小月什么？
questions.questionEn: What does A give Xiaoyue?

lessons.description: Make plans, give choices and talk about how things are going
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 还是 / 是不是 / 一边…一边…

grammar.title: A 还是 B？ — A or B?
grammar.note: 还是 joins two choices in a question. In statements 'or' is 或者 (later level). 还 alone means 'still, also': 他还在睡觉 / 我还要一杯茶.

grammar.title: 是不是 — isn't it? / is it the case that…?
grammar.note: 是不是 checks a guess: 'Are you ill, by any chance?'. It can go before the verb or at the end: 你生病了，是不是？

grammar.title: 一边…一边… — while
grammar.pattern: 他一边吃饭，一边看手机。
grammar.note: Two actions at the same time, by the same person. Put 一边 before each verb.

sentences.zh: 下个星期就放假了，你准备干什么？
sentences.en: The holidays start next week. What are you planning to do?

sentences.zh: 你想去北京还是在家？
sentences.en: Do you want to go to Beijing or stay home?

sentences.zh: 你是不是不高兴？— 没事儿。
sentences.en: Are you upset? — I'm fine.

sentences.zh: 我试一下儿这个包，行吗？— 行。
sentences.en: Can I try this bag? — Sure.

sentences.zh: 这个手机坏了，不能用了。
sentences.en: This phone is broken; it doesn't work anymore.

sentences.zh: 他一边听歌，一边写汉字。
sentences.en: He writes characters while listening to music.

sentences.zh: 明天上午我要开一个重要的会。
sentences.en: I have an important meeting tomorrow morning.

sentences.zh: 我的工作做了一半，还有一半。
sentences.en: I've done half my work; half is left.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 放假了！你准备干什么？
dialogue.en: The holidays are here! What are you going to do?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我还没想好。去北京还是在家休息？
dialogue.en: I haven't decided. Go to Beijing or rest at home?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 去北京吧！在家没什么好玩儿的。
dialogue.en: Go to Beijing! There's nothing fun about staying home.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我的汉语还差一点儿。
dialogue.en: My Chinese still isn't quite good enough.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 没事儿，你去试一下儿。说汉语对你很有用。
dialogue.en: Never mind — give it a try. Speaking Chinese will be really useful for you.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 行，我去！
dialogue.en: OK, I'll go!

lines.zh: 爸爸今天要开一个很重要的会。
lines.en: Dad had a very important meeting today.

lines.zh: 他的电脑非常慢。
lines.en: But his computer was really slow.

lines.zh: 爸爸生气了，他说：“这个电脑太差了！”
lines.en: Dad got cross and said, 'This computer is terrible!'

lines.zh: 我说：“用我的电脑吧！”他笑了：“没事儿了！”
lines.en: I said, 'Use my computer!' He smiled: 'All fine now!'

questions.question: 爸爸的电脑很慢。
questions.questionEn: Dad's computer was slow.

questions.question: 最后爸爸用了谁的电脑？
questions.questionEn: Whose computer did Dad use in the end?

lines.zh: A：你在干什么？
lines.en: A: What are you doing?

lines.zh: B：我一边听歌，一边学汉语。
lines.en: B: I'm learning Chinese while listening to songs.

lines.zh: A：一边听歌一边学，有用吗？
lines.en: A: Does studying while listening help?

lines.zh: B：很有用！我学了半年，学到了很多。
lines.en: B: Very much! I've been doing it for six months and learned a lot.

questions.question: B 学了半年。
questions.questionEn: B has been studying for six months.

questions.question: B 一边听歌，一边干什么？
questions.questionEn: What does B do while listening to songs?

lessons.description: Talk about experiences, actions in progress and famous places
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 过 / 正在 / 次

grammar.title: Verb + 过 — have ever done
grammar.pattern: 我去过北京。你吃过包子吗？— 没吃过。
grammar.note: 过 after a verb means you have had the experience at some time. Negative: 没 + verb + 过 (没去过). 次 counts times: 去过两次.

grammar.title: 正在 + verb (+ 呢) — in progress
grammar.note: 正在 (or 正) before a verb means the action is happening right now. 呢 at the end is common in speech. Negative: 没 + verb (他没在上课 / 他没上课).

grammar.title: Adjective + 地 + verb — how it's done
grammar.note: 地 (de) links a description to the verb that follows: 慢慢地走 = walk slowly. It is pronounced like 的 but written differently.

sentences.zh: 你去过中国吗？
sentences.en: Have you ever been to China?

sentences.zh: 我去过两次，上次是去年。
sentences.en: I've been twice; the last time was last year.

sentences.zh: 下次我们一起去吧。
sentences.en: Let's go together next time.

sentences.zh: 北京有很多有名的地方。
sentences.en: Beijing has lots of famous places.

sentences.zh: 你给我打电话的时候，我正在开车。
sentences.en: When you called me, I was driving.

sentences.zh: 这个包很重，里边有一些书。
sentences.en: This bag is heavy; there are some books inside.

sentences.zh: 门票不大贵，五十块。
sentences.en: The tickets aren't very expensive — fifty yuan.

sentences.zh: 很多外国人来中国学习。
sentences.en: Lots of foreigners come to China to study.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你去过国外吗？
dialogue.en: Have you ever been abroad?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 去过一次。你呢？
dialogue.en: Once. You?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我没去过。你去了哪个国家？
dialogue.en: I never have. Which country did you go to?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 中国。我去了北京，看了很多有名的地方。
dialogue.en: China. I went to Beijing and saw lots of famous places.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 真好！我也想去。
dialogue.en: Lovely! I want to go too.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 下次我们一起去吧！
dialogue.en: Let's go together next time!

lines.zh: 这是北京一个很有名的地方，门票十块。
lines.en: This is a famous place in Beijing; tickets are ten yuan.

lines.zh: 早上这里有一些老人，他们正在一起打球。
lines.en: In the morning there are some old people here playing ball together.

lines.zh: 他们的动作很慢，很好看。
lines.en: Their movements are slow and graceful.

lines.zh: 我也跟他们认真地学了一会儿。
lines.en: I also carefully learned from them for a while.

questions.question: 门票多少钱？
questions.questionEn: How much is a ticket?

questions.question: 老人们的动作很快。
questions.questionEn: The old people's movements are fast.

lines.zh: A：你来过这儿吗？
lines.en: A: Have you been here before?

lines.zh: B：来过。上次我是跟爸爸妈妈来的。
lines.en: B: Yes. Last time I came with my parents.

lines.zh: A：我们在哪儿见你的朋友？
lines.en: A: Where are we meeting your friend?

lines.zh: B：就在门口。我的朋友正在那儿等我们。
lines.en: B: Right at the entrance. My friend is waiting for us there.

questions.question: B 没来过这儿。
questions.questionEn: B has never been here.

questions.question: B 的朋友在哪儿等？
questions.questionEn: Where is B's friend waiting?
